meta.title: Search the PR list by the PR number given to you
gaps: No dedicated catalog step asserts that the PR list contains only the searched PR's lines or that the opened detail page contains all and only that PR's lines.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: No dedicated catalog step asserts that the PR list contains only the searched PR's lines or that the opened detail page contains all and only that PR's lines.

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions area as the buyer.
Ensure the searchable PR list is on the Open tab.

args.goal: In the Open Purchase Requisitions list, enter the supplied PR number 0110000195 in the search box, press Enter, verify that only that PR's lines remain, click the PR number, and stop on its detail page showing all of its lines

steps.note: Perform the PR-number search and open the matching PR detail page, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Confirm the target PR number is visible on the resulting detail page.
